description_en: Deletes instances in a dedicated resource group. You can delete only pay-as-you-go instances as a regular user
description_zh: 删除专属资源组中的机器实例，普通用户仅允许删除后付费实例
kebab_example: aliyun eas delete-resource-instances --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-asdasdasd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteResourceInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the resource group belongs
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The instances. Separate multiple instances with commas (,), such as `instanceId1,instanceId2`. For more information about how to query the instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412129.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例列表，多个实例之间以半角逗号（,）分割。例如：`instanceId1,instanceId2`。如何获取实例列表，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412129.html
parameters.name: instance_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete all the instances that fail to be created. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除全部创建失败实例。
true：表示删除全部失败实例。
false：表示不删除失败实例
parameters.name: all_failed
